tagline: The customer at the center of everything we do
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. Net interest income is the bank's primary driver, reflecting the trajectory of interest rates and credit portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between income generated from loans and the cost of deposits.
kpis.description: NII grows due to better loan rate re-pricing compared to refinancing costs.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by a high interest rate environment.

kpis.name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of costs relative to total revenue, measuring operational efficiency.
kpis.description: BBVA is reducing structural costs while maintaining revenues, supported by digital transformation.

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Key indicator of financial strength, measuring high-quality capital.
kpis.description: The CET1 ratio remains robust, reflecting prudent risk management and internal capital generation.
kpis.signal: High solvency ratio, well above regulatory minimums.

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net profit grows strongly in 2024, driven by NII and low loan loss provisions.
kpis.signal: Double-digit profit growth, supported by interest rates and credit quality.

kpis.name: Digital Customers
kpis.explanation: Number of customers using online or mobile banking services.
kpis.description: BBVA continues attracting customers to its digital platforms, improving experience and reducing costs.
kpis.signal: High digital penetration, a sign of successful transformation.

kpis.name: Loan Loss Provisions
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential loan losses.
kpis.description: Provisions decline in 2024, thanks to a healthy portfolio and favorable economic conditions.
kpis.signal: Lower provisions, reflecting stable credit quality.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.6 EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 4.196 Bn EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 39.9% in the latest year.

ai_positioning.summary: BBVA is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its customer services and internal processes, without positioning it as a public strategic pillar. The focus is on automation and improving user experience.
evidence: Use of AI chatbots for customer service
Personalization of offers via machine learning
